cards.title: Squares: quick review
cards.body: Know the squares to $15^2$. Ending in $5$: $n \times (n + 1)$, then $25$. Next square: add $n$ and $n + 1$.

cards.title: Building squares: quick review
cards.body: Split into a round number and a small one: $(20 + b)^2 = 400 + 40b + b^2$. Check the last digit: $b^2$ decides it.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Squares outside school?
